ios.desc:
Never Forget Anything Important Again

Birthdays, anniversaries, tasks, or client follow-ups... forgotten again?? WishZard is a WhatsApp Reminder App that sends all your reminders directly to WhatsApp, so you never miss what matters.

One App for All Your Reminders

WhatsApp Reminders
Get reminders directly on WhatsApp, the app you check the most. No missed notifications and no switching apps.

Birthday and Anniversary Reminders
- Never forget birthdays again. 
- Never miss anniversaries. 
- Auto-repeat every year. 

Stay close to people who matter.

Client Reminder App
- Client birthdays or work anniversaries. 
- Follow-ups. 
- Meetings. 

Look professional by always being on time.

Daily Reminder and Task Reminder
- Daily habits.
- Work tasks. 
- Important to-dos. 

Stay productive without stress.

Schedule Any Reminder
Set:
• One-time reminders
• Daily reminders
• Weekly reminders
• Monthly reminders
• Yearly events

Everything in one place.
Simple Reminder App
No complexity. No clutter. 
Just set → relax → get reminded.

Fully Flexible
Edit, delete, or update reminders anytime in seconds.

Who Is WishZard For?
• Forget important dates easily
• Want to improve relationships
• Busy professionals managing clients
• Students tracking deadlines
• Anyone who uses WhatsApp daily

Why Users Love WishZard
Because it solves real problems:
- Forgot a birthday
- Missed an anniversary
- Forgot a client follow-up

→ WishZard makes sure it never happens again.

Features at a Glance
• WhatsApp Reminder App
• Birthday Reminder
• Anniversary Reminder
• Client Reminder App
• Task Reminder
• Daily Reminder
• Simple Reminder App
• Schedule Notification App

Download WishZard Now

Because remembering = caring. 
And now, you will never forget anything again.

quotes.text:
Wishzard is an innovative reminder app designed to make your life easier. With Wishzard, you can effortlessly set reminders and deliver them directly to your WhatsApp. Choose a category that suits your reminder, and let Wishzard take care of the rest.

Key Features:

* Wishzard sends your reminders directly to your WhatsApp, ensuring you effortlessly stay on top of your tasks and commitments.
* Personalize your reminders by selecting a category that fits the nature of your task. Whether work-related, personal, or a special event, Wishzard has you covered.

Download Now:
 Play Store - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.app.wishzard&pcampaignid=web_share
 App Store - https://apps.apple.com/in/app/wishzard/id1672184325
